description: This file defines the AiSuggestionService class, which acts as a high-level orchestrator for AI suggestions. It wraps the AiSuggestionsRepository to fetch latest suggestions and request new suggestions based on categories.

classes.name: AiSuggestionService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to access and request AI suggestions, functioning as an orchestrator between higher-level application logic and the repository layer.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Fetches the most recent AI suggestions, with an optional limit defaulting to 10.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Requests a new AI suggestion for a specified category.
